messages:
Aisha (PM): Heads-up: kickoff for the multiplexed invocation behavior spec. Customers keep asking for parallel tool calls inside a single chat turn (e.g., 3 lookups + rerank) but we need to nail SLOs + failure semantics before committing to API surface.

Tom (Eng): +1. Could we scope an MVP that supports best-effort parallelism with deterministic ordering opt-in? e.g., default = unordered parallel, opt-in param `order=preserve` for callers who need sequence.

Kevin (SRE): We need to define SLA targets up-front. Proposal: for Dedicated/hosted tiers, 95p latency for N=3 parallel calls should be <= 2x single-call baseline. Also retry budgets per-root-request to avoid thundering herd.

Joel (ML): Important: model-related toolcalls (e.g., external reranker) increase tail latency unpredictably. We should surface per-tool timeouts and an overall request deadline.

Aisha (PM): Agreed. Draft MVP scope suggestion:
- API: `invoke.tools = [{id, input, timeout_ms, idempotency_key, preserve_order?}]` (support array of calls)
- Semantics: start all calls in parallel, collect results; if `preserve_order` true, return in request order otherwise best-effort fast-path
- Retries: per-tool retry budget + global retry budget (configurable)
- Fallback: on partial failure, respond with `results[]` + `failures[]` and `overall_status`

Tom (Eng): Sketch of client-visible proto:```json
{
  "calls": [
    {"tool": "db_lookup", "input": "q1", "timeout_ms": 400},
    {"tool": "api_x", "input": "q2", "timeout_ms": 800}
  ],
  "preserve_order": false,
  "global_deadline_ms": 1500
}
```
(we can refine shapes later)

Kevin (SRE): Operational notes: must emit per-call metrics: start_ts, end_ts, outcome (ok/timeout/error), retried_count, backend_zone. Also expose a composite signal `multiplex_failure_rate` to trigger fallback to sequential mode.

Joel (ML): Launch criteria idea: 1) correctness: deterministic behavior for preserve_order + clear partial-failure model 2) perf: <2x median latency at N=3 for 80% of customer workloads in bench 3) observability: per-call traces and replayable failure logs 4) safety: idempotency support for side-effecting tools.

Aisha (PM): Customer asks to prioritize two scenarios: a) multi-retrieval + rerank (most common) b) parallel enrichment calls (3rd-party APIs). For (a) we should add a helper mode `merge_rerank=true` that collects text candidates and runs internal reranker as a final step.

Tom (Eng): Implementation risks: KV-cache interactions (shared prefix caching across parallel calls) and backpressure on GPU-bound reranker. Need circuit-breakers per-tool and a queue-depth multiplier hashed by caller for Dedicated.

Kevin (SRE): Canary plan: roll feature as opt-in per-customer flag. Start with small internal customers, verify metrics for 72h, then widen. Add automatic soft-fallback: if `multiplex_failure_rate` > 1% for 5m, flip to sequential for that customer.

Aisha (PM): Prioritization asks: engineering estimate for MVP + canary? Tom?

Tom (Eng): Rough: core runtime + API ergonomic layer + metrics hooks ~ 6 dev-weeks. Reranker helper + preserve_order deterministic path + retry budgets ~ 4 more weeks. Total ~10w to canary. Could parallelize some work with infra team (Kevin) to speed up to ~8w.

Joel (ML): Post-launch: we should add quality evals that ensure rerank ordering fidelity when `preserve_order` is used and alert on distributional regressions.

Aisha (PM): Acceptance checklist (MVP):
- [ ] API spec doc + SDK examples
- [ ] Runtime: start-parallel + collect semantics implemented
- [ ] Per-call metrics + traces ingest
- [ ] Retry budget config + documented defaults
- [ ] Canary gating automation + playbook
- [ ] Customer-facing docs + examples for retrieval+rerank

Tom (Eng): I'll split tickets and post a tech design in #eng-runtime by EOD.

Kevin (SRE): I'll draft canary automation and metric dashboards.

ops-bot: Deploy plan created: canary flag `enable_multiplex_invokes` for 3 customers. Target window next Tue 0200-0600 UTC.

Aisha (PM): Thanks all — will consolidate notes into a spec doc and ping legal for idempotency guidance on side-effecting toolcalls. @Tom @Kevin please +1 timeline in the design thread. :raised_hands:
